meta.name: The Jack Hanna Channel
meta.description:
TV-gids · geen videostreams.
Bijgewerkt: 28-11-2026 07:41 UTC
Tijden hieronder: America/New_York.

28-11 02:22–02:46  Jack Hanna's Passport
  Jack Hanna's family visits rheas and chinchillas, sloths, and feed manatees and foxes.
28-11 02:46–03:11  Jack Hanna's Passport
  The Hannas explore primates, including baboons, orangutans, silver langurs, and lemurs.
28-11 03:11–03:36  Jack Hanna's Passport
  Jack Hanna's family explores nighttime wildlife: sea turtles, bats, Tasmanian devils, and the Amazon.
28-11 03:36–04:25  Jack Hanna's Passport
  The Hannas visit disabled dogs, a farm sanctuary, relocate bighorn sheep, and meet a saved bird species.
28-11 04:25–04:49  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Check out the fascinating behaviors of bears, leopards, honey bees, camels and more!
28-11 04:49–05:14  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack as he counts down seven creatures so bizarre, you’ve gotta see them to believe them!
28-11 05:14–05:38  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack as he meets up with some of nature’s biggest eaters!
28-11 05:38–06:03  Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
  Join Jungle Jack on whale watching safari to Catalina Island where he meets a humpback whale!
28-11 06:03–06:28  Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
  Jack is heading to the island-nation of Curacao for some quality time with its winged residents!
28-11 06:28–06:52  Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
  Join Jack and his family as they trek deep into the jungles of Rwanda!
